source: Broadberry, Campbell, Klein, Overton, van Leeuwen (2010), English Economic Growth, 1270-1700: table 1 (total arable) and table 19 (people; kilocalories per head and day from arable farming)
method: the people of each decade are spread over the 162 places of England as on the map in 1356; landLimit and arablePerHead are set so that the places together cultivate the arable of 1300 and of 1380, englandLand so that they bring in the harvest of 1300-09
